refreshed_main.subject: fix(workflow): route hosted Apple jobs to macOS 26

supported_sidecar.authority: transport only; trusted B must parse/authenticate later

preflight_assertions: Freeze repository identity, current main parent, PR/base/head, merge method, final target SHA/tree, closure, workflow/action/config blobs.
Compare target commit/tree and refs/heads/main expected parent before build and immediately before CAS update.
Build B only from exact frozen target; clean detached checkout; binary revision and closure self-reports equal manifest.
B final release, assets, custom binding, standard provenance, and live API checks complete before main ref update; draft-only fails.
Prove source.ref refs/heads/main claim for pre-main build via exact target commit/CAS or custom owner-signed transaction predicate; staging/PR relabel fails.
Handoff all policy consumers: pull_request_target ci-policy, push-main ci-main Policy, push-main Preview identity, and any selected release/policy path.
Required B-backed check proves exact workflow path/blob, source SHA/tree, event, repository, PR, actor/integration, attempt, job, conclusion, and B identity.
Reject current ruleset strict=false, zero reviews, and context-only Policy unless protected transition supplies equivalent exact binding.
First main push contains complete Linux-X64, Linux-ARM64, and xcode-27 macOS-ARM64 application matrix; reject macos-26/15/latest, skip, empty, if:false, reroute.
After main update, assert every push run exact head SHA/branch/event/workflow source and B use before accepting.
negative_cases: B built from PR or staging SHA but manifest claims refs/heads/main
GitHub merge/squash/rebase changes planned target SHA or tree
main advances between B publication and CAS merge
B release is draft, asset/attestation missing, tag target/source mismatched, or same closure has different source
artifact name/run ID matches but job/check/step/attempt binding is stale or ambiguous
publisher workflow path/blob, repository, event, branch, run attempt, or source SHA mismatches
base ci-policy changed but ci-main Policy or Preview identity still uses 0dc
same-name Policy check from wrong workflow/integration satisfies context
old --force normalized current raw drift and result was claimed as source admission
candidate manifest, --pin-build, local checkout, app runtime product, fallback, mutable latest, or self-attested sidecar used
runtime matrix has macos-26, macos-15, macos-latest, missing xcode-27, skipped, empty, or rerouted native cell
application runtime publisher replaced by Linux-only B product or namespace
B publisher starts after main push and relies on first-main workflow ordering
sidecar not rendered by old 0dc or old unknown config section is introduced
unresolved_gaps: No current repository workflow can build and publish B before the first main push; a new PR workflow cannot bootstrap itself under base pull_request_target.
A normal pre-main GitHub Actions run cannot truthfully carry refs/heads/main provenance before that ref exists; exact commit/CAS or custom owner transaction is not implemented.
Current protect-main permits stale required checks (strict=false), zero approvals, and all merge methods; exact target binding is not guaranteed.
Current required Policy context has no visible integration binding; same-name check spoofing/staleness needs protected identity enforcement.
Current first-main push has multiple policy consumers; a pull_request_target-only handoff is incomplete.
Current main d20 old checker raw tree is not fixed point; --force normalization cannot be used as proof.
Current d20 runtime success on macos-26 violates the latestOS rule even though old 0dc accepts macos-*.
conclusion: Conditionally viable only with a real protected pre-main source-bound B publisher, complete old-to-B policy handoff, atomic target-SHA main update, and exact required-check identity. No approval.
